sources: sizes: the hotel's own capacity chart (https://courtlandgrandhotel.com/floor-plan-capacity-charts/, read 2026-10-03). The chart gives each room's area and not its sides: the sides are the whole feet whose product is the chart's area and whose shape is the plan's

placement, order and orientation: the hotel's own floor plan, reference/plans/courtland-grand-site-2024-level-3.webp, the picture of level 3 on the same page (2194 x 1734 px), measured from the two banks of elevators it draws (DECISIONS #28: read for position only, nothing copied)
which rooms the con uses, what it calls them and which way is north: Dragon Con's 2026 map, reference/dragoncon/ (read only)
notes: the Grand Ballroom, on the Courtland Street side, above the front drive: the Grand Prefunction along its north end and the Grand Foyer down its east side, towards the elevators

the venues file's Grand Ballroom A to F are the hotel's Salons A to F: A, B and C down the east side, north to south, and D, E and F down the west, with the Salon Hallway, 20 ft wide and inside the ballroom, between the two columns. The ballroom is 130 x 116 ft in the chart

A and D are 54 ft north to south, B and E 55, C and F 21; each is 48 ft wide but F, which is 46 and is drawn against the hallway. F's 46 is its own row's 966 sq ft; the chart's combined rows, Salon D-F and E-F, count it as 1,008, which is 48

the plan draws the ballroom larger than the chart: measured from the two banks of elevators, as the other two floors are, it is about 122 x 140 ft. It is drawn at the chart's 116 x 130, centred on the plan's, so its north and south walls are about 5 ft inside the plan's, and the South Tower elevators stand just south of its south wall's line where the plan has them just north of it
the Salon Hallway is the chart's 130 x 116 less the two columns of salons; the Grand Prefunction and the Grand Foyer are drawn by eye
